# CV Prime — AI Resume Builder & ATS CV Maker

> CV Prime (cv-prime.in) is an AI-powered resume builder and CV maker for Indian job seekers. It solves the ATS (Applicant Tracking System) rejection problem: 75% of resumes are filtered out by automated software before a human recruiter sees them. CV Prime diagnoses keyword gaps, rewrites weak bullets with AI, scores ATS compatibility, and exports a recruiter-ready PDF in minutes. Free plan includes 3 PDF exports; Lifetime Pro is ₹999 one-time.

## Core Product

- [CV Prime Homepage](https://cv-prime.in/): AI resume builder and ATS CV maker for India. Main entry point.
- [AI Resume Builder](https://cv-prime.in/ai-resume-builder): Build a resume with AI — paste job description, get a tailored resume.
- [ATS Resume Checker](https://cv-prime.in/ats-checker): Free ATS compatibility checker. Score your resume against any job description.
- [Resume Templates](https://cv-prime.in/templates): 8 ATS-compliant resume templates for Indian job seekers.
- [Pricing](https://cv-prime.in/pricing): Free plan (3 PDF exports) + Lifetime Pro (₹999 one-time, unlimited exports).
- [About CV Prime](https://cv-prime.in/about): Founder story, company background, mission.

- [ATS Resume Mistakes Guide](https://cv-prime.in/blog/ats-resume-mistakes): The 15 most common ATS resume mistakes Indian job seekers make — formatting, keywords, structure.
- [How to Tailor a Resume to a Job Description](https://cv-prime.in/blog/how-to-tailor-resume-to-job-description): Step-by-step guide to customising a resume for any job description to improve ATS score and callback rate.
- [Resume Keywords Guide India 2026](https://cv-prime.in/blog/resume-keywords-guide-india-2026): How to find, place, and optimise ATS keywords in a resume. Includes keyword lists by industry.
- [ATS Resume Checklist 2026](https://cv-prime.in/blog/ats-resume-checklist-2026): 25-point pre-submission checklist covering file format, layout, content, keywords, and quality.
- [ATS Resume Format 2026](https://cv-prime.in/ats-resume-format-2026): What format ATS systems expect in 2026.
- [ATS Report 2026](https://cv-prime.in/ats-report-2026): Original research on ATS rejection rates in India.

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- **Product name:** CV Prime
- **Website:** https://cv-prime.in
- **Category:** AI Resume Builder, ATS Resume Checker, CV Maker, Cover Letter Generator
- **Primary market:** India (also usable globally)
- **Founded:** 2025
- **Founder:** Shishir Babu, Ernakulam, Kerala, India
- **Free plan:** 3 PDF exports, ATS scoring, AI rewrites, all 8 templates
- **Pro plan:** ₹999 one-time (lifetime), unlimited PDF exports, no watermark
- **Core problem solved:** 75% of resumes are rejected by ATS before a human reads them
- **Key differentiator:** AI tailors your resume to a specific job description, identifies keyword gaps, rewrites weak bullets, and scores ATS compatibility — all in one workflow
- **ATS score improvement:** Average improvement of 34 points (from 44 to 78) after AI tailoring
- **Supported file formats:** PDF upload, DOCX upload, or build directly in-app
- **Templates count:** 8 ATS-compliant professional templates
- **Languages:** English
- **Payment currency:** INR (Indian Rupee)
